description.value: Las Tortas Mexican Gourmet Sandwiches is a sit-down Mexican restaurant on Main Street in Vancouver specializing in housemade tortas served for lunch and dinner. The restaurant accepts reservations and also offers in-store pickup, making it a flexible stop for riders passing through the Main Street cycling corridor. It has been operating since at least 2020 and received a recent OSM verification in May 2026.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active with matching address (4328 Main Street), phone (604-708-0445), and in-store pickup. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags; the website content is minimal at ~1069 bytes and mostly homepage navigation. The OSM check_date of 2026-05-09 and active website confirm the business is currently open.
concerns: Website content is very sparse (1069 bytes); no cycling-specific amenities, washroom access, or water refill information could be confirmed.
None of the three required WWC criteria are confirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate restaurant on a high-traffic cycling street in Vancouver, but the minimal website content leaves all three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) unconfirmed. On-site verification is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Main Street is a designated cycling route in Vancouver; a brief on-site visit would likely confirm washrooms and possibly a nearby public bike rack, which could support inclusion.
